decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - A review of the travel plan submitted to Council on the 7th June 2004 shall be undertaken, submitted to Council and approved prior to the opening of the Health Centre.  the travel plan shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details.  This review shall discuss the success of the travel plan during the decant phases and further measures designed to reduce the reliance on the car.
description: Following approval  of erection of a new 3, 4 and 5 storey Health Centre building and new 4 and 5 storey building containing 79 one and two bedroom flats with associated parking and landscaping and access off Bath Road and Hospital Road - details submitted pursuant to Condition 21 (Travel plan/car park management plan) of approved planning permission ref 00083/92/P5 dated 02/08/2004
